## History

Julia Bell is a student at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school and an associate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her circle of friends. She joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and other local youths as a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Through her participation in the society, she attends local meetings to discuss community matters, including efforts to preserve the village's appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P6](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P7](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P8](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0008), +93 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia Bell is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two attended school together, where Julia once copied a poem for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their shared connection is rooted in their local community and school environment in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Friend of — schoolmate who copied a poem for her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)</sub>
